attorneys: Messrs. John F. Finerty, Thomas H. Stone, and Morris Shapiro for petitioner. Mr. Abram P. Staples, Attorney General of Virginia, for respondent. Mr. Thur-good Marshall filed a brief on behalf of the American Civil Liberties Union, as amicus curiae, in support of petitioner.

opinions.text: The motion for leave to proceed on the typewritten record is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Appeals of Virginia is denied.
